drivingQuestion: What sign of life must an animal in danger of imminent death show at its slaughter for the slaughter to be valid?
outcomeNote: A mishnaic dispute recorded without adjudication; the anonymous close extends the rule to both animal sizes and restricts it to an animal presumed moribund.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט אֶת הַמְסוּכֶּנֶת, רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: עַד שֶׁתְּפַרְכֵּס בַּיָּד וּבָרֶגֶל. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: דַּיָּהּ אִם זִינְּקָה. אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן: הַשּׁוֹחֵט בַּלַּיְלָה, וּלְמָחָר הִשְׁכִּים וּמָצָא כְּתָלִים מְלֵאִים דָּם – כְּשֵׁרָה, שֶׁזִּינְּקָה, וּכְמִדַּת רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: עַד שֶׁתְּפַרְכֵּס אוֹ בַיָּד אוֹ בָרֶגֶל, אוֹ עַד שֶׁתְּכַשְׁכֵּשׁ בִּזְנָבָהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal «that is in danger» of imminent death, «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:» The slaughter is valid «only» in a case «where» after the slaughter «it convulses with its foreleg and with its hind leg. Rabbi Eliezer says: It is sufficient if» blood «spurted» from the neck. «Rabbi Shimon says:» In the case of «one who slaughters at night and the next day he awoke and found walls full of blood,» the slaughter is «valid,» as it is clear «that» the blood «spurted, and» this is «in accordance with the rule of Rabbi Eliezer. And the Rabbis say:» It is valid «only» in a case «where it convulses with its foreleg or with its hind leg, or» in a case «where it wags its tail.»

segments.he: אֶחָד בְּהֵמָה דַּקָּה וְאֶחָד בְּהֵמָה גַּסָּה, בְּהֵמָה דַּקָּה שֶׁפָּשְׁטָה יָדָהּ וְלֹא הֶחְזִירָה – פְּסוּלָה, שֶׁאֵינָהּ אֶלָּא הוֹצָאַת נֶפֶשׁ בִּלְבָד. בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים? שֶׁהָיְתָה בְּחֶזְקַת מְסוּכֶּנֶת, אֲבָל אִם הָיְתָה בְּחֶזְקַת בְּרִיאָה, אֲפִילּוּ אֵין בָּהּ אֶחָד מִכׇּל הַסִּימָנִים הַלָּלוּ – כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: This is the halakha with regard to «both a small animal,» e.g., a sheep, «and a large animal,» e.g., a cow, that is in danger of imminent death. The slaughter of «a small animal that» when being slaughtered «extended its foreleg» that was bent «and did not restore» it to the bent position «is not valid, as» extending the foreleg «is only» part of the natural course of «removal» of the animal’s «soul» from its body and not a convulsion indicating life. «In what» case «is this statement said?» It is in a case «where the presumptive status» of the animal «was» that it was «in danger» of imminent death. «But if its presumptive status was» that it was «healthy,» then «even if there were none of these indicators,» the slaughter is «valid.»

moves.summary: limits the whole requirement to an animal of presumed moribund status; a presumptively healthy one needs no sign
moves.about: all of these signs of life are demanded only where the animal had the presumptive status of being moribund; a presumptively healthy animal needs none of them
